The three-part exclusive newsbreak by Soumya Pillai has once again put the spotlight on the two and a half front threat India has faced for decades. Watch , where ThePrint Editor-In-Chief Shekhar Gupta argues India has faced multiple and multi-layered threats since 1959 and its Army has been the political leadership’s go-to option. With one exception—1962—it has delivered each time.
The print edition of this was published on 8 July, 2017.
